name: read_gripper_contract
summary: Expose profile-declared gripper limits, geometry axes, mounting, TCP offset, and live aperture without model guesswork.

generality.rationale: The tool reads standardized Kinex gripper profiles and is independent of object class, task, scene, robot brand, and perception method.
assumptions: The gripper exposes Kinex control, aperture, frames, geometry, and mount profile fields.
The profile calibration accurately represents the active hardware or simulator.
limitations: It reports declared limits but does not prove collision safety or grasp suitability.
It cannot infer missing finger-pad dimensions that the device profile does not calibrate.

level.rationale: It performs one bounded introspection operation and normalizes profile fields into a planner-facing contract.

composition.strategy: Read and validate one device profile plus its live aperture state.

provenance.failure_gap: Qwen issued out-of-range gripper commands because it guessed the gripper control convention.
evidence: iter_001 contains three gripper target bound violations
